_provenance.selection: asteroids with a measured diameter above 50.0 km
_provenance.elements: osculating, at each object's own epoch as published
_provenance.note: Real objects on real orbits, propagated as two-body. Each element set has its own epoch, which is honoured rather than assumed common. This is a size-limited selection, not the whole belt: over a million asteroids are known, and drawing a representative scatter instead would be a picture of an idea rather than of anything measured.
